title: TechSinger: Technique Controllable Multilingual Singing Voice Synthesis via Flow Matching

layout.note: Three panels side by side with bold lettered titles underneath: a wide overall architecture, a narrow postnet column and a medium technique predictor with a tinted block. Every panel flows bottom to top, with input cell strips at the base and outputs at the top.

lesson: Draw the generative step as a column (noise picture, solver box with its equation, generated spectrogram) and reuse the colour of each input's token strip in the zoom panel so inputs can be matched between panels.
